text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса shows off her talents and
makes a
successful debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then makes a surprising
declaration—she's
decided not to pursue
the Classic Triple Crown in
her classic
year. Instead, she has her sights set on

the Japan Cup.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She reasons that because her goal is to
be the
world's strongest racer, not her
generation's
strongest, she must take a
different path than her
friends.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her aptitude in mind, we choose
the Kyodo
News Hai for our next race.
It's the perfect length
and at the perfect
time, right after New Year's.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
